description: List all tyre aspect ratios available, optionally filtered by section width and region. Aspect ratio is the sidewall height as a percentage of section width (e.g. 45 in a 245/45R18). Use this to discover valid aspect_ratio values for search-by-tire.

region.description: Market region code (e.g. "eudm", "usdm"). Get codes from list-regions.

section_width.description: Tyre section width in mm (e.g. 245). Must be positive. Use list-tire-section-widths to enumerate valid values.

name: list-tire-aspect-ratios
